data.summary: The meeting began with individual updates from the intern team. Jordan completed the user-settings API refactor, pending infra reviewer approval. Priya finished the Notifications Preferences UI, resolving debounce logic and sending a build to QA. Sam transferred three charts for the analytics dashboard migration, awaiting metrics team fixes for missing-data states. Lina prototyped a new onboarding flow, requiring UX feedback. Marcus improved the file-import tool's performance by 18% and is optimizing error handling. Dylan completed the TypeScript migration for media-upload components, with one flaky e2e test remaining. Noah debugged an OAuth refresh token issue, implementing a fallback path due to an upstream provider problem. Ava worked on the AI recommendation module, needing access to updated embedding snapshots for evaluation. Following updates, supervisors Alex and Elena assigned new tasks for the week to each intern, covering areas like session-timeout improvements, UX flow integration, migration completion, load test coordination, authentication cleanup, diversity scoring, and onboarding iteration. A team decision was made to group all UI-state-management work into a shared module starting next sprint, with the legacy global store to be deprecated over the next two weeks. Interns were reminded to update their progress documents by Friday for a combined milestone summary presentation next week.
decisions: Starting next sprint, all UI-state-management work will be grouped into a shared module for consistency.
The legacy global store will be deprecated over the next two weeks.
